source: User-supplied EXC3_CM3 dataset, kkmfd, approximately 72.28 seconds
observation_method: 4 fps full sequence, selected 12 fps transition windows; numeric audio analysis separately

proposed_descriptor_additions.assembly_id: continuous world identity, separate from framing changes
proposed_descriptor_additions.camera_segments: positions, targets, speed curves and neural owners; segments may change on timing events
proposed_descriptor_additions.scale_distribution: foreground, meso and micro occupied area; not equal size for every component
proposed_descriptor_additions.transition_anchor: component or mask shared between outgoing and incoming framings
proposed_descriptor_additions.event_operations: typed operations on existing components as well as births of new elements

temporal_layers.name: local_articulation
temporal_layers.operation: cell trace, joint impulse, local edge or region change

temporal_layers.name: editorial_change
temporal_layers.operation: reframe, swap material, replace panel, change silhouette

temporal_layers.name: world_development
temporal_layers.operation: develop an assembly across connected framings

grammars.observed: Pale fields with irregular opaque surfaces, localized image fills, small volumes and thin attached construction marks; sharp crops and replacements.
grammars.depth: thin layers that can separate into shallow 3D
composition_rules: Use opaque intersections and explicit masks
Avoid an evenly distributed grid of independent marks
Vary foreground crop rather than filling every gap

grammars.observed: A flat card opens into a related spatial assembly, with views passing between panels, curved forms, symbols and surfaces.
grammars.topology: articulated panels and shared contour ribs
grammars.depth: initially coplanar, then progressively separated with real occlusion
transition: assembly reframed as a small card

neural_mapping.bursts: hinge release and camera segment trigger

composition_rules: Retain component identity through dimensional change
Compose connected components, not random floating primitives
Camera crosses near geometry during selected segments

grammars.observed: Thin converging lines become deep slabs and architectural extrusions; a foreground arc and camera roll frame a strong vanishing point.
grammars.depth: large near/far ratios with surfaces entering and leaving the screen edges
composition_rules: Use a shared perspective axis
Let foreground surfaces clip the image
Do not substitute a sequence of identical torus rings for architecture

grammars.observed: Thin orbital lines and grouped marks assemble in a dark space, rotate into depth and alternate with closer graphic views.
grammars.depth: thin structures retain perspective and layered occlusion
composition_rules: Paths belong to one construction
Annotations are localized and optional
Do not imply plotted lines are actual synaptic paths unless real adjacency is used

grammars.observed: A hard split grows into vertical partitions; perspective imagery and rounded forms intersect selected panels.
grammars.depth: flat frame organization around selected deep views
composition_rules: Hard masks separate dense regions
Avoid a permanent equal-sized dashboard grid
Changing one panel need not reset the world

grammars.observed: A circle or word silhouette persists while its internal imagery changes much faster; corruption stays related to the mask.
grammars.topology: persistent aperture with changing internal world
grammars.depth: foreground mask with a separate internal perspective
composition_rules: Geometry replaces word masks in most shots
Do not bundle reference photography
Internal cuts can be rapid while the motif remains coherent

grammars.observed: Reflective folded surfaces and sharp perspective deformation fill much of the frame; occasional graphic framing reinforces the fold.
grammars.depth: surface curvature and self-occlusion rather than many floating objects
composition_rules: The surface is the space, not a busy backdrop behind unrelated objects
Keep readable broad curvature
Reflection must not erase the silhouette

grammars.observed: An existing composition becomes a screen or framed object within another graphic space.
grammars.depth: separate screen plane and surrounding scene
composition_rules: Bound recursion and reuse render targets
No filesystem capture in the render loop
Keep previous content recognizable through the transition

not_sufficient: same mesh with a new color
